title: Normalized quotient coefficient comparison squares
statement: Fix the prime ell, finite coefficient extension E and canonical quotient coefficient presentations of [lem-coef-compact-support-quotient-native]. Let c compactify f:X -> Y. For every level n and arbitrary H in D(X_proet,A_n), the identity coefficient square is sigma_nn;idRes_Y=F_n(idRes_X). If f is separated and finite type and ell is a unit in every stalk of Y, then for n <= m <= r the composition square is F_r(compRes_X);sigma_rn = sigma_rm;Res_rm(sigma_mn);compRes_Y. The identity statement has no stalk-invertibility or finite-type assumption. The comparisons are the actual normalized quotient comparisons, including their specified identity and direct-quotient equality casts. There is no integral input object or cocycle for additional arrows in these squares.

theorem compactSupportQuotientNativeComparison_comp
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hl : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (c : Compactification f) (r m n : ℕ) (hrm : m ≤ r) (hmn : n ≤ m)
    (H : proEtaleDerivedCategory X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))) :
    (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (r + 1)) c).map
        ((compactSupportQuotientNativeResComp l E X r m n hrm hmn).hom.app H) ≫
          (compactSupportQuotientNativeComparison l E c r n (hmn.trans hrm)).hom.app H =
      (compactSupportQuotientNativeComparison l E c r m hrm).hom.app
          ((compactSupportQuotientNativeRestriction l E X m n hmn).obj H) ≫
        (compactSupportQuotientNativeRestriction l E Y r m hrm).map
          ((compactSupportQuotientNativeComparison l E c m n hmn).hom.app H) ≫
        (compactSupportQuotientNativeResComp l E Y r m n hrm hmn).hom.app
          ((sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).obj H)
